meta.title: FEAT-001 · Register, verify, sign in, sign out
meta.subtitle: Design solution from technical-design.md: the components this slice builds or changes, the contract on every arrow, and the decisions behind them. Pick a flow to follow one use-case path; click any arrow for its data contract.
meta.description: A browser uses the storefront SPA, which calls the gateway BFF. The gateway routes /v1/users to Identity, proxies OIDC endpoints and exchanges tokens server to server, keeps tokens in an encrypted cookie whose keys live in Azurite blob, and relays a bearer token to protected APIs. Identity writes users and an outbox in identitydb and publishes events to Service Bus; Notification consumes them, records emails in notificationdb and sends through Mailpit. The email link brings the browser back to the verify page.
overview: Identity (OIDC server), BFF, Notification email path
Access 15 min, refresh 7 d with rotation
meta.footnote: Source: docs/features/FEAT-001-register-and-sign-in/technical-design.md (§3 contracts, §4 schema, §5 components, §7 decisions, §8 open items). Protected APIs are a placeholder for FEAT-002 onward. Generated with html-flow-diagram; edit design-flow.model.json and rebuild.

nodes.label: Browser
nodes.desc: The visitor registering and signing in. Holds only the encrypted hs.bff cookie and the Identity session cookie hs.idp; never a token.

nodes.label: Storefront SPA
nodes.desc: Auth pages on the shared AuthLayout (D-1). features/auth/api.ts is the only API-client import; sends X-HS-CSRF: 1 and Accept-Language on every call; session store fed by GET /bff/user.

nodes.label: Gateway + BFF
nodes.desc: Confidential OIDC client. Serves /bff/login, /bff/callback, POST /bff/logout, /bff/user; refreshes tokens near expiry; validates the JWT on authenticated routes and relays it; rejects non-GET /v1/* without the CSRF header.

nodes.label: Identity
nodes.desc: Handlers RegisterUser, VerifyEmail, ResendVerificationEmail, SignIn; OpenIddict authorize, token, revoke, logout, discovery. Argon2id hashes (D-3), SHA-256 token hashes, ES256 keys from configuration (D-7).

nodes.label: identitydb
nodes.desc: Migration 0001_InitialIdentity: users, credentials, role_grants, verification_tokens, outbox, inbox, OpenIddict tables.

nodes.label: Service Bus
nodes.desc: Outbox relay (1 s poll, at least once). Notification's subscription has no filter; it dispatches by eventType.

nodes.label: Notification
nodes.desc: Event dispatcher → contacts (upsert contact) and emails (record + send). Jinja2 templates in vi and en; link {PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/verify-email?token=….

nodes.label: notificationdb
nodes.desc: Alembic 0002_contacts_and_emails; unique (event_id, template) gives one email per event. No token stored.

nodes.label: Azurite blob
nodes.desc: ASP.NET Data Protection key ring for the hs.bff cookie (container dataprotection).

nodes.label: Protected APIs
nodes.desc: Any route with the authenticated policy. Receives Authorization: Bearer, X-User-Id, X-User-Roles; inbound copies are stripped.

all.title: FEAT-001 design solution
all.intro: Six paths: register, verify, resend, sign in, an authenticated call with refresh, and sign out.

steps.t: Submit the form: POST /v1/users with CSRF and language headers.
Validate every rule at once; 400 lists all failures, 409 identity.email_in_use.
One transaction: unverified user, credential, Buyer role, token hash, outbox. Returns 201 without waiting for email.
UserRegistered is relayed to Notification, at least once.
Exactly one email: inbox + record in one transaction, then send in the registration language.
Open the link on the storefront verify page.
POST /v1/users/verify-email with the token.
Hash and look up: 204 sets email_verified_at; invalid, expired or already-verified return their designed errors.
POST /v1/users/verification-email; always 202 (no enumeration).
Unverified only: invalidate earlier tokens, issue a new one.
VerificationEmailRequested → a new email.
/bff/login → /connect/authorize; no session, so Identity redirects to /signin.
POST /v1/users/sign-in: password checked (verified or not); sets hs.idp. Same 401 for every bad credential.
Authorize again with the session; Identity issues a code to /bff/callback.
Code exchange server to server: access 15 min, refresh 7 days.
Encrypted hs.bff cookie set; the browser never sees a token.
Call a protected route with the cookie.
Refresh if the access token expires within 60 s; rotated tokens replace the cookie. Failure → 401.
Relay the validated bearer plus X-User-Id and X-User-Roles.
Same-origin form POST to /bff/logout.
Revoke the refresh token at Identity and delete hs.bff.
/connect/logout clears hs.idp and returns to /.

notes.b: Storefront pages on a shared AuthLayout in packages/ui, not Identity-hosted Razor pages.
Otherwise hs.idp would sign the user straight back in.

notes.t: Issuer is the public gateway origin
notes.b: Keys load from configuration PEM so sessions survive restarts; discovery fetched via MetadataAddress.

notes.t: Argon2id; credential in its own table
notes.b: Google-only accounts (FEAT-004) simply have no credential row.
Never logged, never stored by Notification, outbox rows deleted after 24 h.
A failed first email is not retried; the user recovers with resend.
Add VerificationEmailRequested to the event catalog and amend ADR-0008's hosted-pages bullet.
